title: Lemma 6.2: asymptotic for S_1 with smooth F
statement_scope: Let y be chosen from a smooth F supported on R_k by y_{r_1,...,r_k}=F(log r_1/log R,...,log r_k/log R) on the permitted square-free support. With F_max=sup over [0,1]^k of |F|+sum_i |partial_i F|, S_1 equals phi(W)^k N (log R)^k/W^(k+1) times I_k(F), plus O(F_max^2 phi(W)^k N (log R)^k/(W^(k+1) D_0)), where I_k(F) is the integral of F^2 over [0,1]^k.
